subject: Mythology
title: Samsara: The Cycle of Rebirth
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Samsara: The Cycle of Rebirth.

hook.text: Hindus believe the soul is eternal, cycling through countless lives as humans, animals, and even gods.

buildup.text: Each life is shaped by karma from previous lives. A virtuous life leads to a better rebirth; a harmful one, to worse.

discovery.text: The soul, or atman, is trapped in samsara until it achieves moksha — liberation from the cycle entirely.

twist.text: Samsara is not a gift. It is considered suffering. The goal of Hindu spirituality is to escape the wheel, not ride it.

climax.text: This concept shaped an entire civilization's view of death: not an ending, but a transition to the next lesson.

punchline.text: Death is not the end. It is a transfer to the next classroom.

quiz.question: What is the Hindu goal regarding the cycle of samsara?
options: To be reborn into the highest possible caste
To achieve moksha and escape the cycle entirely
To accumulate enough karma for rebirth as a god
